INSERT INTO omikuji.processed_events (
                transaction_hash, log_index, contract_address, 
                event_type, event_data
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (transaction_hash, log_index) DO NOTHING
            RETURNING 
                id,
                transaction_hash,
                log_index,
                contract_address,
                event_type,
                processed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' as "processed_at!",
                event_data
